- Comparison notes: The panel shows the whole newest round (defense card, hit card, damage card) from real recorded payloads; the style rows are struck through with their reasons and the hit stat stays unstruck. Two differences from the demo are approved: off-style armor keeps the style's armor share (Armor, 5 of 10, not struck), per the owner ruling of 2026-11-01 recorded in the issue 4884 body, and the defense result reads the outcome then the damage taken (Partial Success, 8 damage) instead of Evaded, barely, as approved by the maintainer. The admin reorders the demo's flat field list into Attack, Defense and Who learns it fieldsets and rewords some help lines with the same meaning; the Gear kinds inline now carries the demo's help line but lists one row per kind where the demo shows Attack and Defense summary lines. Notes that are not defects: bystanders still see the damage dealt to the opponent, by design; at phone width the shared admin header strip is wider than the screen (607px) on every admin page, outside this change, while the style page's own content fits; the style list table is wider than 390px on phone.
- Tested interactions: Recorded a real round in the Postgres test database: Mira with The Daring Dance Struck a Blade through the web dispatch with a one-handed sword, then the Blade struck her in light armor through resolve_round, her real Parry check forced to Partial Success; read the rows back through the consequence-outcomes endpoint as Mira and as a bystander; opened the style change and list pages as a superuser
- Fixture/live boundary: Live code: CombatTurnPanel, the serializers, the roll recording, the combat style admin and its CSS. Fixture: the forced check outcomes, the factory-built style, character and weapon, the interception of the unrelated empty endpoints (magic, inventory, companions), and the hand-set dark or light class because the harness has no realm theme provider; the admin pages were captured with the admin's own JavaScript removed
- Overall outcome: PASS
